feeds.title: True Vintage Guitar Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the new home of True Vintage Guitar! Curated by John Shults, each guitar and amplifier is meticulously chosen, inspected, and presented with passion. Whether buying, selling, or browsing, visitors discover a treasure trove of vintage gear, accompanied by news, tips, and rare finds.

feeds.title: Scruffs Vintage Guitar Blog
feeds.description: In the heart of Texas's Hill Country, Scruffs Vintage Guitars stands as a cherished sanctuary for enthusiasts of aged instruments. Specializing in vintage, top-tier stringed instruments and amplifiers, their dedicated team shares a profound love for music. With a keen eye for quality, they meticulously select the finest vintage guitars, offering personalized guidance to each customer, be it a professional musician, collector, or hobbyist.

feeds.title: Gibson Gazette Blog
feeds.description: The Gibson Gazette, Gibson Brands' digital hub, offers guitar enthusiasts a wealth of guitar news, product releases, artist interviews, and tutorials. Its seasoned editorial team, boasting decades of industry expertise and contributions to top publications like Guitar World and MusicRadar, ensures comprehensive coverage and insightful content for fellow guitar aficionados.

feeds.title: Know Your Vintage Guitars Blog
feeds.description: Know Your Vintage Guitars stands as Belgium's leading vintage guitar boutique, curating a unique selection of high-end guitars and amps. With meticulous care, they ensure the authenticity and quality of each instrument, reflecting their genuine passion for vintage gear. Their personalized service guarantees a seamless experience, whether in-store or through long-distance shipping, underscoring their commitment to customer satisfaction.

feeds.title: IVG Blog
feeds.description: The IVG Blog is a haven for vintage guitar enthusiasts, offering insights into rare and six-stringed treasures. From iconic Gibsons to handcrafted luthier creations, their passion for music history shines through. With a commitment to quality, they curate a diverse collection of vintage, new, and used instruments and amps.

feeds.title: Elite Vintage Guitars Blog
feeds.description: Elite Vintage Guitars boasts a collection spanning over 45 years, focusing on Japanese and USA vintage guitars. Recognized by Guitar Magazine in June 2019, this extensive array showcases rare and coveted instruments curated by a seasoned guitarist.

feeds.title: Vintage Guitar Legacies Blog
feeds.description: Based in Scottsdale, Arizona, performing artist and guitar curator Sarah James brings the world of vintage guitars to life through her engaging video podcast. Each episode of Vintage Guitar Legacies highlights a unique guitar with its own special characteristics and story. Featuring a variety of special guests to discuss and demo these incredible instruments, the channel offers a dynamic and entertaining way to explore the legacy of vintage guitars.

feeds.title: Vintage Guitar World
feeds.description: Vintage Guitar World is an online platform focused on high-quality vintage, handcrafted, and restored guitars. It offers a curated selection of instruments, including classical, flamenco, acoustic, and electric guitars, all inspected and set up by expert luthiers. The site also shares news, deals, and updates related to guitars and the guitar community.

feeds.title: Vintage and Rare Blog
feeds.description: The Vintage And Rare blog promises thrilling updates, insightful interviews, captivating narratives, and exquisite instruments. With a mission to foster the ultimate network for vintage, rare, and antique musical instrument enthusiasts, retailers, and dedicated builders, it's poised to become a cornerstone in the community.

feeds.title: Vintage Guitar Nerds » Blog
feeds.description: Vintage Guitar Nerds, founded by Dimitris Loizos in July 2018, is a global community dedicated to preserving and sharing the passion for vintage electric guitars. Though based in London, UK, they plan to establish a physical store in the future. Their mission is to keep vintage guitars alive, advocating for their use in making music rather than keeping them in glass cases.

feeds.title: All Good Vintage Guitars Blog
feeds.description: At All Good Vintage Guitars, Jim Anderson, a semi-retired IT professional, shares his lifelong passion for guitars. With a focus on buying and selling vintage guitars, he has amassed a collection of coveted instruments, each with a unique story. Jim values connections, fostering a vibrant community of collectors and celebrities who share his love for these treasures. Explore detailed tips on selling vintage guitars, including photography techniques and buyer red flags.

feeds.title: Joes Vintage Guitars Blog
feeds.description: At Joe's Vintage Guitars, Joe Dampt shares his passion for guitars and music. With a love for classic tunes from the 50s and 60s, Joe's journey led him to make music his life's work. He believes in playing guitars rather than just collecting them, enjoying styles like classic country, swing, and rock. Explore Joe's collection and adventures in music and outdoor exploration.

feeds.title: Davidson's Well Strung Guitars Blog
feeds.description: The blog on Well Strung Guitars covers vintage gear, guitar history, and instrument breakdowns. It features guides on identifying and pricing old guitars, stories about iconic models from artists like The Rolling Stones, and deep dives into gear like Gibson's Les Paul SGs.

feeds.title: Pure Vintage Blog
feeds.description: Pure Vintage serves as the ultimate platform for vintage enthusiasts, offering a seamless marketplace experience without transaction fees. Buyers and sellers connect directly via private messaging, ensuring smooth transactions. Explore unique finds like popcultcases' phone cases and waterproof speakers adorned with digital paintings of vintage guitars. For a personal touch, commission a custom hand-painted digital portrait of your beloved guitar.
